policy.cache: No cache eviction or discarded warmups; hashing warms file cache; order rotates
policy.calamine: Worksheet cell stream; no Range and no RPyXL copy
policy.checksum: Executable's noncryptographic scalar checksum is a comparison gate, not a fidelity proof
policy.cpu: Last sampled user+system seconds; lower bound, final sample may precede exit
policy.mode: Cached scalar values only; no formula evaluation or generation
policy.native: Full native Workbook, then borrowed cell iteration
policy.rss: Absolute sampled child RSS, not parent RSS or exact allocation high-water mark
policy.security: Shared ZIP prevalidation; native rechecks; XML security differs
policy.semantics: All runs must agree on ordered sheet names, nonempty bounds/counts, checksum_cells and scalar_checksum; zero excluded cells
policy.timing: Use backend_total_with_drop for combined open/load + consume + drop; phase boundaries differ
policy.types: Raw type histograms retained, not compared; executable normalizes exactly integral float/int checksums; empty storage may differ
policy.wall: External child lifetime also includes startup and JSON output

summary.scope: This invocation only; no historical aggregation

plain.reason: All outputs fully validated and semantic digests agree

styled.reason: All outputs fully validated and semantic digests agree

writer_20000x20_completed_cases.qualification: Full invocation incomplete: parent deadline after one formula child timeout. Only plain and styled completed all seven repetitions per backend. Exclude incomplete formulas and unstarted dates/control from performance conclusions. Native code from 42b0ffb with local Python fixes subsequently committed at 88ffb13; not the exact final wheel.
